p.src: For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of the LORD.

en: For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of the LORD.
u.src: For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of the LORD.

p.src: 1  A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

en: A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
u.src: 1  A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

p.src: 2  For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.

en: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.
u.src: 2  For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.

p.src: 3  The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

en: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
u.src: 3  The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

p.src: 4  He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.

en: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
u.src: 4  He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.

p.src: 5  Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

en: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
u.src: 5  Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

p.src: 6  Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.

en: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.
u.src: 6  Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.

p.src: 7  How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

en: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
u.src: 7  How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

p.src: 8  They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

en: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
u.src: 8  They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

p.src: 9  For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.

en: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.
u.src: 9  For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.

p.src: 10  Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

en: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
u.src: 10  Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

p.src: 11  Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

en: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
u.src: 11  Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

p.src: 12  There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

en: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
u.src: 12  There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
